fah-396.title: Waffle & Pancake Sandwiches
fah-396.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-396.culturalNotes: Serve the sandwiches with fresh fruits and vegetables for a balanced meal. They keep in a lunchbox and can be served cold.

instructions.1: For the pancakes: grease the sandwich maker with oil and pour in the pancake mix.
instructions.2: Close the machine and leave for 2–3 minutes until cooked.
instructions.3: Take out the pancakes and serve with fruits and honey or powdered sugar.
instructions.4: For the sandwiches: grease the iron with oil and add pancake batter.
instructions.5: Add the tomatoes, olives, turkey, and cheese.
instructions.6: Close the machine and leave for 2–3 minutes until cooked.
instructions.7: For bread sandwiches: spread labneh and the kids' favorite filling.
instructions.8: Fold the sandwiches and cut them in half.
instructions.9: Place skewers on the sandwiches and fill them.
instructions.10: For the hash potatoes: boil water and add the grated potatoes for 3 minutes.
instructions.11: Drain the potatoes and dry them well.
instructions.12: Add the spices, starch, and egg; mix well.
instructions.13: Place the potatoes in the sandwich maker and leave until cooked.

fah-397.title: Kofta Burger Sandwiches with Secret Marinade & Soft Bread
fah-397.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-397.culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is cohesive and doesn't crack while kneading. Extra bread can be frozen for later use.

instructions.1: To prepare the burger buns:
instructions.2: Mix the flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the egg whites, vinegar, and yogurt; mix well.
instructions.4: Add the warm water gradually and knead the dough for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Add the butter-oil mixture and knead for 5 more minutes.
instructions.6: Place the dough in an oiled dish, cover, and let it rise for an hour.
instructions.7: To prepare the kofta burgers:
instructions.8: Chop the onion, red pepper, green pepper, and garlic in the food processor until smooth.
instructions.9: Add the burger seasoning, salt, black pepper, and ground meat; mix well.
instructions.10: Shape the kofta into patties and grill them on a tray over medium heat until cooked.
instructions.11: To prepare the caramelized onions:
instructions.12: Fry the onion in oil until golden.
instructions.13: Add the sugar, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper; stir until the onion is soft.
instructions.15: Cut the dough into balls the size of a large lemon.
instructions.16: Grease the baking sheet with oil, flatten each ball with soft butter, and shape into ovals.
instructions.17: Bake the loaves in a hot oven for 10 minutes.
instructions.19: Layer the sauce, special vegetables, kofta burger, caramelized onions, tomatoes, and cheese between the two halves of bread.

fah-398.title: Fluffy Sandwiches with Assorted Fillings
fah-398.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-398.culturalNotes: Use any fillings you like — seasoned meat, pizza toppings, or your favorite vegetables. Keep in the fridge for 2 days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water and buttermilk or yogurt and knead well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and mix until the dough is soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise until doubled.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into small balls and cover them.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a floured surface until round and medium-thick.
instructions.7: Brush the surface with butter and fold in half.
instructions.8: Cover the dough again and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush the sandwiches with egg or cream and sprinkle with breadcrumbs if desired.
instructions.10: Brown the sandwiches in hot oil or bake in a hot oven until golden.
instructions.11: Let the sandwiches cool slightly, then serve with your favorite fillings.

fah-399.title: Magic Dough Sandwiches
fah-399.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-399.culturalNotes: Use any fillings you like — cooked meats or chopped vegetables. The dough keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in the warm water and set aside for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix the flour, milk powder, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise, and the yeast mixture to the flour and knead until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes or until doubled.
instructions.5: Divide the dough in two: use the first half in small pieces for sandwiches and the second for a large pizza.
instructions.6: Roll the dough for sandwiches into thin rounds and add your favorite fillings (cheese, chicken, peppers, tomatoes, olives).
instructions.7: Seal the sandwiches well and place on an oiled baking sheet.
instructions.8: Brush the sandwiches with milk mixed with sugar and salt, and sprinkle with nigella and sesame seeds.
instructions.9: Bake at high heat (about 200°C) for 15 minutes or until golden.

fah-400.title: Hurry-Up Tray (Kofta with Vegetables)
fah-400.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-400.culturalNotes: For a grilled flavor, place a hot coal in a small dish inside the covered tray for 10 minutes before serving.

instructions.1: Mix the ground meat with the minced onion, salt, pepper, seven-spice, and garlic.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture well until the meat fibers bind.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers as desired.
instructions.4: Toss the thinly sliced onion with salt, pepper, and cumin until wilted.
instructions.5: Place the onion in the baking tray, then add the carrots, potatoes, and colored peppers; mix well.
instructions.6: Arrange the kofta over the vegetables.
instructions.7: Add the tomato sauce and boiling water; mix well.
instructions.8: Cover the tray with foil and bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Lower the heat to 180°C and continue cooking until the kofta and vegetables are done.
instructions.10: Serve with white rice and salad.

fah-401.title: Vegetable & Chicken Tagine with Doum-Date Rice
fah-401.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-401.culturalNotes: Serve the tagine and rice with pickles and olives for a complete meal. Extend the cooking time for a more done dish.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into cubes.
instructions.2: Slice the bell peppers, hot pepper, and tomatoes thinly.
instructions.3: Slice the garlic and red pepper.
instructions.4: Cut the onion into wedges.
instructions.5: Add the spices (Knorr potato seasoning, salt, cumin) to the onion and garlic and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the onion-garlic-spice mixture to the vegetables and toss well.
instructions.7: Wash the chicken, rinse it, and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.8: Add the chicken to the vegetable mixture and toss well.
instructions.9: Place the mixture in a tagine, add 3 tablespoons of oil and the red pepper, then add a cup of hot water and the Knorr sauce; mix well.
instructions.10: Bake the tagine in a hot oven until cooked.
instructions.11: Brown the vermicelli in 2 tablespoons of oil and a spoonful of ghee until golden.
instructions.12: Wash the rice, drain it, add it to the vermicelli, and mix well.
instructions.13: Add the salt and Knorr stock to the rice and mix well.
instructions.14: Add 4 cups of boiling water to the rice and mix well.
instructions.15: Cover the rice and leave over high heat until cooked, then keep covered over low heat.
instructions.16: Blend the doum juice, sugar, ground doum, milk, water, ice, and nuts until smooth.
instructions.17: Strain the juice and serve it cold.
instructions.18: Serve the tagine and rice hot with the juice.

fah-402.title: Happiness Sauce (Glazed Chicken Wings)
fah-402.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-402.culturalNotes: Use any chicken pieces you prefer. Marinate the chicken well for a distinctive flavor. The sauce keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the smoked paprika, onion powder, instant stock, black pepper, garlic powder, minced garlic, ketchup, lemon juice, vinegar, white honey, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Stir the ingredients until combined.
instructions.3: Wash the chicken wings and open them with a sharp knife.
instructions.4: Coat the wings with the mixture on all sides, especially inside.
instructions.5: Refrigerate the wings for 2–3 hours to set.
instructions.6: Preheat the oven to high heat.
instructions.7: Place the wings on a rack in a tray with 2 cups of boiling water in the bottom.
instructions.8: Bake until the wings are roasted.
instructions.9: In another bowl, melt the butter, add the minced garlic, and sauté until golden.
instructions.10: Add the white honey, ketchup, and chopped parsley; season with salt and pepper.
instructions.11: Stir the ingredients until combined.
instructions.12: Brush the sauce over the roasted wings.
instructions.13: Serve hot with spiced rice or pasta in sauce, plus salad and pickles.

fah-403.title: Sujuk, Potato & Mozzarella Tray Bake
fah-403.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-403.culturalNotes: Serve the tray with pasta, or with bread, salad, and pickles. You can also eat it straight from the tray with a spoon.

instructions.1: Peel and wash the potatoes, then cut them into equal cubes.
instructions.2: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat, add the potatoes, and stir with a pinch of salt.
instructions.3: Fry the potatoes until golden and crispy.
instructions.4: Slice the onion and colored peppers thinly.
instructions.5: Cut the sujuk into medium cubes.
instructions.6: Heat a little oil in another pan over high heat, add the sujuk, and stir until golden.
instructions.7: Add the onion, peppers, and minced garlic to the sujuk; stir together.
instructions.8: Add the salt, black pepper, and coriander; stir until fragrant.
instructions.9: Add the barbecue sauce and stir together.
instructions.10: Place the fried potatoes in a baking tray, then top with the fried sujuk.
instructions.11: Blend the milk, flour, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
instructions.12: Pour the milk mixture over the potatoes and sujuk in the tray.
instructions.13: Top with the mozzarella and cheese blend.
instructions.14: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20–30 minutes until the cheese melts and browns.

fah-404.title: Alexandrian Potato & Sujuk Tray
fah-404.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-404.culturalNotes: Make sure the tomatoes cook down well before adding the potatoes so they don't get mushy. Serve the tray with rice for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Cut the sujuk into medium pieces.
instructions.2: Heat a pan over heat and add a spoonful of oil.
instructions.3: Add the sujuk and stir until browned and nicely colored.
instructions.4: Add the onion cut into wedges and stir with the sujuk.
instructions.5: Add the cumin, black pepper, dried coriander, and salt. Stir well.
instructions.6: Add the minced garlic and pureed tomatoes. If the tomato color is weak, add 2 tablespoons of sauce.
instructions.7: Let the mixture thicken, stirring occasionally.
instructions.8: Add the boiling water and the stock cube. Let it boil.
instructions.9: Cut the potatoes into medium rings and add them to the mixture.
instructions.10: Let the potatoes absorb the flavors until tender.
instructions.11: Serve in a serving dish. It pairs well with rice.

fah-405.title: Breakfast Frittata Tray
fah-405.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-405.culturalNotes: Add any other ingredients like mushrooms or spinach. The tray keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs and milk in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the flour, salt, black pepper, paprika, and baking powder. Mix well.
instructions.3: Add the finely diced colored peppers, onion, parsley, and tomatoes. Mix together.
instructions.4: Add the feta cheese and mix.
instructions.5: Add a quarter cup of oil and mix the batter well.
instructions.6: Grease a baking tray with ghee and dust with flour.
instructions.7: Pour the mixture into the tray.
instructions.8: Arrange the salami and cheese on top.
instructions.9: Add a sprinkle of thyme.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C.
instructions.11: Leave until golden.
instructions.12: Cut the tray into pieces and serve hot with a cup of mint tea.

fah-406.title: Potato & Sujuk Tagine
fah-406.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-406.culturalNotes: Serve the tagine with bread and pickles for a delicious, complete dish.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into fingers.
instructions.2: Slice the onion into thin wedges.
instructions.3: Cut the bell peppers and hot peppers.
instructions.4: Crush 6 garlic cloves with a little salt.
instructions.5: Place the potatoes in the tagine.
instructions.6: Add the onion and bell peppers and mix together.
instructions.7: Add the salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, and half the crushed garlic.
instructions.8: Toss until the onion wilts.
instructions.9: Spread the mixture over the potatoes in the tagine.
instructions.10: Arrange the sujuk over the potatoes.
instructions.11: Place the hot peppers in the center.
instructions.12: In a pan, heat a little oil, add the remaining crushed garlic, and sauté until golden.
instructions.13: Add the tomato sauce and grated tomatoes; stir.
instructions.14: Add a pinch of sugar, the stock cube, and 2 cups of boiling water.
instructions.15: Let the sauce simmer until it thickens.
instructions.16: Add a pinch of paprika for a red color.
instructions.17: Pour the sauce over the tagine and spread it evenly.
instructions.18: Bake the tagine in a preheated hot oven for 30 minutes until the potatoes and sujuk are cooked.

fah-407.title: Fava Bean & Egg Tagine
fah-407.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-407.culturalNotes: Serve the tagine for breakfast or suhoor. A clay tagine can be used instead of Pyrex.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over heat.
instructions.2: Add the minced onion and sauté until wilted without coloring.
instructions.3: Add the chopped hot and bell peppers and stir for a minute.
instructions.4: Add the tomatoes cut into small cubes and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the salt and black pepper and stir for a minute.
instructions.6: Add the cooked fava beans and stir well.
instructions.7: Mash the beans slightly with a fork and add a little water to prevent the mixture from drying out.
instructions.8: Stir the mixture and let it boil over heat for a minute.
instructions.9: Transfer the mixture to an oven-ready tagine.
instructions.10: Crack the eggs over the surface of the mixture.
instructions.11: Season the eggs with salt and black pepper.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated hot oven for 10 minutes until the eggs set.
instructions.13: Garnish the tagine with the red chili pepper and parsley.

fah-408.title: Chicken Pasta Tagine
fah-408.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-408.culturalNotes: Serve the tagine hot with a green salad or fresh bread. It keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pan over high heat and add the chicken cubes. Sear well until golden, without stirring too much.
instructions.2: Add the chicken seasoning and black pepper; mix well.
instructions.3: Add the minced onion and hot pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until the onion wilts.
instructions.4: Remove the mixture from the heat and set aside.
instructions.5: In another pot, heat the oil and add the tomato juice, sugar, salt, cumin, coriander, stock cube, and sauce. Stir well and let it boil.
instructions.6: Add boiling water and let the mixture boil again.
instructions.7: Grease a tagine with oil on all sides.
instructions.8: Layer the chicken on the bottom of the tagine, then add the raw pasta, then the sauce.
instructions.9: Add water to cover the pasta.
instructions.10: Cover the tagine with foil and bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 30 minutes.
instructions.11: After 30 minutes, leave the tagine covered for 10 more minutes.
instructions.12: Turn the tagine onto a serving plate and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.

fah-409.title: Seasoned Potato Skillet
fah-409.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-409.culturalNotes: Serve the skillet with bread or any other type. Add other spices like chopped coriander or chili to taste.

instructions.1: Place a pot over heat and add the water and salt. Cut the potatoes into medium cubes.
instructions.2: Drop the potatoes into the boiling water and cover. Cook until two-thirds done, without mashing them.
instructions.3: Drain the potatoes well from the water.
instructions.4: In a skillet, add a spoonful of butter and 2 garlic cloves; sauté.
instructions.5: Add a spoonful of paprika, a pinch of black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Stir well.
instructions.6: Add the potatoes to the skillet and toss well in the mixture.
instructions.7: Add the finely chopped red pepper, green onion, and chopped parsley. Stir together.
instructions.8: Add the mixed cheese and cover the skillet for 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
instructions.9: Serve the skillet hot alongside bread.

fah-410.title: Egg Skillet with Pastrami & Vegetables
fah-410.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-410.culturalNotes: Substitute small diced chicken pieces for the pastrami if you like. Serve with toasted bread or a light salad.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a skillet over heat.
instructions.2: Add the pastrami and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the mushrooms and tomatoes cut into small cubes; stir for a minute or two until seared.
instructions.4: Add the eggs and stir gently until the eggs are half-set.
instructions.5: Add the black pepper and salt; stir well.
instructions.6: Add the cheese, lower the heat, and cover the skillet until the cheese melts.
instructions.7: Serve the skillet hot.

fah-411.title: Breakfast Skillet (The Bomb)
fah-411.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-411.culturalNotes: Serve the skillet hot with griddle bread or Egyptian feteer. Garnish with chopped parsley.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the hot pepper and stir for a minute.
instructions.4: Add the fava beans and water; stir well.
instructions.5: Add the cumin, black pepper, and salt; stir well.
instructions.6: In another pan, fry the potatoes until golden.
instructions.7: Add the fava beans to the fried potatoes.
instructions.8: Pour the mixture into an oven-safe skillet.
instructions.9: Add the eggs on top of the mixture.
instructions.10: Add the shredded cheese over the eggs.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes until the cheese is golden.

fah-412.title: Budget Breakfast Skillet
fah-412.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-412.culturalNotes: Add cheese to taste for extra flavor. Serve the skillet with pickles for a distinctive taste.

instructions.1: In a pot, place boiling water with a pinch of salt and soak the potatoes in it for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: In a skillet over heat, add a spoonful of oil and slice the onion thinly.
instructions.3: Add the onion to the oil and sauté with a pinch of sugar and salt until golden and caramelized.
instructions.4: Remove the potatoes from the boiling water and place them in another skillet with a spoonful of oil.
instructions.5: Sauté the potatoes over heat until nicely colored.
instructions.6: Add the paprika and salt to the potatoes and toss well.
instructions.7: Add the caramelized onions to the potatoes and mix together.
instructions.8: Add the eggs with a pinch of salt and black pepper and stir gently.
instructions.9: If you like, add a sprinkle of cheese and let it melt while the eggs set.
instructions.10: Add a sprinkle of parsley or coriander and crushed chili to taste.
instructions.11: Serve hot with bread and pickles.

fah-413.title: Egg & Cheese Skillet
fah-413.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-413.culturalNotes: Use different cheeses to taste. Add other vegetables like tomatoes or sweet peppers for flavor.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a skillet over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the minced onion and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the peppers and tomatoes to taste and stir with the onion.
instructions.4: Add the salsa and spices (salt, paprika, black pepper, thyme); stir well.
instructions.5: Add the beaten eggs to the mixture and stir gently.
instructions.6: Lower the heat and place the cheese on top.
instructions.7: Cover the skillet and leave over low heat until the cheese melts.
instructions.8: After five minutes, check that the cheese has melted and the eggs have absorbed the sauce flavor.
instructions.9: Serve the skillet hot with an extra sprinkle of thyme.

fah-414.title: Breakfast Skillet with Potatoes & Eggs
fah-414.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-414.culturalNotes: Serve the skillet with bread and your favorite drinks. Add cheese to taste.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a skillet over heat.
instructions.2: Add the potatoes cut into small cubes and stir for 2 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the salt and let them cook until dry.
instructions.4: Cover the skillet for 2–3 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
instructions.5: Add the chopped sweet pepper and stir with the potatoes.
instructions.6: In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with salt and black pepper.
instructions.7: Pour the beaten eggs over the potatoes and peppers.
instructions.8: Add the shredded cheese over the mixture.
instructions.9: Cover the skillet and leave over low heat until the eggs set and the cheese melts.
instructions.10: Serve hot with a sprinkle of crushed pepper.

fah-415.title: Breakfast Skillet with Eggs & Qarish Cheese
fah-415.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-415.culturalNotes: Add crushed pepper to taste for a spicy flavor. Serve the skillet hot with bread or fries.

instructions.1: Heat the skillet over heat.
instructions.2: Add a spoonful of ghee, oil, or butter — whatever is available.
instructions.3: Cut the boiled meat into small pieces.
instructions.4: Beat the eggs in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add the eggs to the skillet and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the salt and cardamom and stir together.
instructions.7: Cut the qarish cheese into small pieces.
instructions.8: Add the qarish cheese to the eggs and stir together.
instructions.9: Cut the green and red peppers to taste.
instructions.10: Add the green and red peppers to the skillet and stir with the mixture.
instructions.11: Add the black pepper and crushed pepper and stir together.
instructions.12: Leave the mixture over heat until cooked and golden.

fah-416.title: Restaurant-Style French Fries
fah-416.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-416.culturalNotes: Don't freeze raw potatoes — par-fry them first until pale blond before freezing. Choose red potatoes for the best result.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into slightly thick sticks.
instructions.2: Fry the potatoes in oil until pale blond.
instructions.3: Spread the potatoes on kitchen paper to absorb excess oil.
instructions.4: Pack the potatoes in bags and store in the freezer.
instructions.5: When ready to use, fry them again in oil until golden.

fah-417.title: Fasters' Bread (Lenten Bread)
fah-417.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-417.culturalNotes: Serve fasters' bread with butter, cheese, or honey. Keep it in a sealed plastic bag for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, milk powder, yeast, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the ghee or oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the buttermilk or yogurt and the vinegar and knead until the dough is soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into small balls and shape into discs.
instructions.6: Cover the discs and let them rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to high (about 220°C) for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: Place the discs on an oiled tray and bake for 10–15 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: After the bread comes out of the oven, mist it with sugar water for a nice shine.

fah-418.title: Fino Bread with Eggs & Cheese
fah-418.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-418.culturalNotes: Add any cooked meats like pastrami or diced chicken if available. Serve this pastry for breakfast, dinner, or lunch.

instructions.1: Cut the fino bread into small pieces and set aside.
instructions.2: In a bowl, beat the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.3: Add the chopped tomatoes and bell pepper to the mixture and mix well.
instructions.4: Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat, add the minced onion, and sauté until wilted.
instructions.5: Add the egg, tomato, and pepper mixture to the onion and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the fino bread pieces to the mixture, then top with the shredded cheese and thyme.
instructions.7: Cover the pan and leave over low heat until the cheese melts.

fah-419.title: Fahita with Fatta
fah-419.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-419.culturalNotes: Serve the dish hot with a green salad or a side of your choice. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Heat ghee in a tray, brush the shami bread or tortilla with it, cut the bread into cubes, and toast in a 220°C oven for 10 minutes until crispy.
instructions.2: In a pot, heat the oil and ghee, then add the onion, bay leaf, cardamom, and mastic. Add the rice and stir well, then add the broth or water and chicken stock. Cover the pot and let the rice cook.
instructions.3: In a bowl, mix the tahini, yogurt, duqqa, cumin, coriander, vinegar, and water until smooth.
instructions.4: Slice the chicken breasts thinly, then mix with the minced garlic, harissa, vinegar, lemon juice, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, chili, thyme, cumin, coriander, black pepper, and salt. Let the chicken marinate for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Slice the onion and colored peppers thinly and grill them in a pan until golden.
instructions.6: In the same pan, grill the chicken until golden, then add the grilled onion and peppers and toss together.
instructions.7: In a large tray, layer the toasted bread, then the rice, then the chicken and grilled vegetables. Pour the sauce over the dish and garnish with dried coriander.
instructions.8: Heat a tablespoon of ghee in a pan, add the chili or paprika, stir, and pour over the dish.

fah-420.title: Eid Breakfast — Mixed Skillet
fah-420.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-420.culturalNotes: Add any other ingredients to taste. The skillet keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

instructions.1: Cut the sujuk in half and separate the pieces.
instructions.2: Slice the hot and sweet peppers and the onion thinly.
instructions.3: Knead the kofta and shape it into balls.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a tray.
instructions.5: Add the hearts first and sear until golden.
instructions.6: Move the hearts to the side of the tray to finish cooking.
instructions.7: Add the couscous and toast it until golden.
instructions.8: Add the liver and cook until done.
instructions.9: Add the onion and peppers and stir well.
instructions.10: Add the salt, black pepper, and bouillon powder; stir together.
instructions.11: Serve the skillet hot with sweets.

fah-421.title: Chicken Fatta
fah-421.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-421.culturalNotes: Use any bread you have instead of shami. Add some chopped parsley to the fatta sauce for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and butter in a pot over medium heat, then add the mastic and the washed, drained rice. Sauté the rice until it glistens and heats through.
instructions.2: Add the salt and toss the rice well. Add boiling water (one cup of water per cup of rice) and the instant stock. Cover the pot, let the rice boil, then stir once, lower the heat, and leave until cooked.
instructions.3: Toast the shami or baladi bread in the oven after brushing it with melted butter. Cut the bread into small cubes.
instructions.4: Blend the washed, drained chicken in the food processor with the Knorr kofta mix. Shape the chicken into small balls.
instructions.5: Heat a pot over high heat and add the butter. Add the chicken balls and sear until browned on all sides. Add half a cup of boiling water, cover the pot, and leave the chicken over low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Prepare the fatta sauce: crush the garlic with salt, then add the tahini, vinegar, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, and yogurt. Mix well.
instructions.7: Assemble the fatta: place the rice on the serving plate, arrange the toasted bread around the rice, top with the chicken balls, and pour over the fatta sauce. Sprinkle with fresh coriander.
instructions.8: Serve the fatta hot.

fah-422.title: Chicken Kofta Fatta
fah-422.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-422.culturalNotes: Use any type of rice instead of basmati. Garnish with toasted nuts and chopped parsley as desired.

instructions.1: To make the kofta: mix the minced chicken breasts with the parsley, coriander, ground breadcrumbs, minced onion, minced garlic, paprika, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and salt.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients well until the mixture holds together.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into small, equal balls.
instructions.4: Brown the kofta in oil over medium heat until golden.
instructions.5: Add water to the kofta and leave over low heat for 10 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.6: To make the rice: wash the rice well and drain it.
instructions.7: Heat the oil in a pot and add the cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, turmeric, stock, and salt.
instructions.8: Add the rice and toss well with the spices.
instructions.9: Add boiling water (two cups per cup of rice) and leave the rice over low heat until cooked.
instructions.10: To make the sauce: mix the mayonnaise, yogurt, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
instructions.11: Toast the shami bread in the oven until golden and crispy.
instructions.12: To serve the fatta: place a layer of rice on the serving plate, then top with the kofta.
instructions.13: Pour the sauce over the kofta and rice.
instructions.14: Scatter the toasted shami bread over the kofta and rice.
instructions.15: Add toasted nuts and chopped parsley as desired.

fah-423.title: Grilled Chicken, Saffron Basmati Rice & Date-Milk Drink
fah-423.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-423.culturalNotes: Serve sliced cucumber, tomatoes, and parsley as a side salad alongside the chicken and rice.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, oil, and shish tawook mix; toss well.
instructions.3: Refrigerate the chicken for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: In a pot over heat, add the ghee and oil and let them heat through.
instructions.5: Add the loomi, cloves, cardamom, bay leaf, and black pepper; toss over heat until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the washed, drained rice and toss over heat until warmed through.
instructions.7: Add the instant stock and salt; mix well.
instructions.8: Add the hot water (4 cups for every 2 cups of rice) and stir the rice well.
instructions.9: Leave the rice over high heat until it boils, then lower the heat and cover the pot.
instructions.10: After 10 minutes, add the raisins and saffron powder to half the pot and mix well.
instructions.11: Cover the pot and let the rice cook over low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.12: Place a piece of charcoal on a heatproof dish, add two drops of oil, cover the pot, and leave for 5 minutes (for a smoky flavor).
instructions.13: Meanwhile, grill the chicken pieces on a griddle until golden.
instructions.14: Add the pitted dates to the milk, add the date molasses, and mix well.
instructions.15: Blend the ingredients until smooth, then pour the drink into glasses.
instructions.16: Serve the grilled chicken and saffron basmati rice with the date-milk drink.

fah-424.title: Breadless Breakfast Envelopes
fah-424.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-424.culturalNotes: Make sure the heat is high and the pan is nonstick. Add other filling ingredients as desired.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, water, and milk; mix well until the batter is smooth and lump-free.
instructions.3: Strain the batter if it has lumps.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over high heat and grease it with a little oil.
instructions.5: Pour a ladleful of batter into the pan and cook until golden on both sides.
instructions.6: Repeat until all the batter is used.
instructions.7: Prepare the filling by mashing the potatoes with the potato seasoning, cheese, colored peppers, green pepper, and green onion.
instructions.8: Add salt to taste and mix the filling well.
instructions.9: Stuff the crepes with the filling and close them into envelope shapes.
instructions.10: Brown them in a spoonful of ghee until golden.
instructions.11: Serve them hot.

fah-425.title: French Coffee & Cheese Croissant
fah-425.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-425.culturalNotes: Use any cheese you have at home on the croissant. Add dried fruit or honey to the coffee for extra flavor.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix half a spoon of cocoa with a heaping spoon of coffee.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of water and half a cup of milk, then stir the mixture well.
instructions.3: Place the mixture over low heat and stir once midway through.
instructions.4: When the coffee starts to boil, drop in the caramel chocolate square and pour the hot coffee over it to help it melt.
instructions.5: Meanwhile, prepare the cheese croissant: place a slice of white or cream cheese on the croissant.
instructions.6: Serve the croissant with the French coffee, garnished with cucumber and tomato.

fah-426.title: Rumi Cheese Crepe Sandwiches with Milk Tea
fah-426.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-426.culturalNotes: Add other ingredients like tomatoes or parsley as desired. The batter keeps in the fridge for one day.

instructions.1: Make the milk tea: place a cup of water and a cup of milk in a pot over low heat, add 2 tea bags and a teaspoon of sugar. Leave over heat for 5 minutes, then remove.
instructions.2: Make the batter: in a bowl, mix half a cup of flour with 1¼ cups of water, a pinch of salt, a pinch of sugar, the egg, and a spoon of oil. Beat well until the batter is lump-free.
instructions.3: Heat a pan over heat, add a small drop of oil, and spread it evenly. Pour a small amount of batter into the pan and swirl until it spreads thin.
instructions.4: Flip the crepe once it takes light color, place the Rumi cheese on one side, and fold over until the cheese warms and melts.
instructions.5: Serve the sandwiches with milk tea, cucumber, and olives.

fah-427.title: Quick Breakfast Pie — No Oven, No Kneading
fah-427.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-427.culturalNotes: Serve the pie with any drink, such as milk tea. Use any cheese you have.

instructions.1: Place a pan over heat and add a tablespoon of butter.
instructions.2: Add the pastrami pieces and leave until they take color.
instructions.3: In another bowl, beat the eggs with salt and black pepper.
instructions.4: Pour the egg mixture over the pastrami in the pan and leave until it starts to set.
instructions.5: Place a shami loaf or tortilla over the egg mixture.
instructions.6: Add the cheese, hot or mild peppers, and olives over the bread.
instructions.7: Add another loaf and press firmly so it holds the ingredients together.
instructions.8: Flip the pie gently until browned on the other side.
instructions.9: Leave until crispy on both sides with the cheese melted inside.

fah-428.title: Quick Breakfast Potato Pie
fah-428.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-428.culturalNotes: Use a small pan and make the mixture in two batches if needed. Add cheese as desired.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes and grate them well.
instructions.2: Squeeze the potatoes to drain the excess water.
instructions.3: Place the potatoes in a deep dish.
instructions.4: Add the egg, milk, salt, pepper, baking powder, and flour.
instructions.5: Stir the mixture well until combined.
instructions.6: Heat a 28 cm pan over medium heat.
instructions.7: Add a spoonful of butter and let it heat up.
instructions.8: Pour the mixture into the pan and spread it evenly.
instructions.9: Cover the pan and leave until cooked and browned on the bottom.
instructions.10: Flip the pie to the other side until browned.
instructions.11: Sprinkle the shredded cheese on top if desired.
instructions.12: Cover the pan again until the cheese melts.
instructions.13: Transfer the pie to a serving plate.
instructions.14: Garnish with chopped parsley or green onion.
instructions.15: Cut it into triangular pieces like a pizza.

fah-429.title: Pizza Boats with Budget Dough
fah-429.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-429.culturalNotes: The boats can be frozen and used when needed. Serve them for breakfast or dinner.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt or buttermilk and the oil; mix well.
instructions.3: Add the warm water gradually until the dough is soft and slightly sticky.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes until soft and cohesive.
instructions.5: Cover the dough with plastic and leave in a warm place for one hour until doubled.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into egg-sized balls and cover with a clean towel.
instructions.7: Roll each ball out in an oval shape, spread with labneh, then add the filling (cheese, pastrami, olives, tomatoes, peppers).
instructions.8: Fold the edges to shape the boats.
instructions.9: Place the boats in a tray greased with oil and dusted with flour.
instructions.10: Brush the boats with the mixture of egg, milk, Nescafe, and sugar.
instructions.11: Let the boats rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Serve them hot with your favorite sauce.

fah-430.title: Kunafa Cups with Shawarma
fah-430.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-430.culturalNotes: Serve the kunafa shawarma cups hot or cold. They keep in the fridge for 2 days.

fah-430-i1.name: Chicken breasts, cut into shawarma strips

instructions.1: Mix the chicken breasts with the shawarma mix and 3 tablespoons of oil, then refrigerate for 15 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix half a cup of oil with the kunafa and toss well.
instructions.3: Press the kunafa into cupcake molds greased with ghee.
instructions.4: Bake the molds at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.5: Mix the tahini with the water, lemon juice, and garlic, then add the mayonnaise and yogurt and stir well.
instructions.6: In a pot over heat, add the shawarma with the onion, red pepper, yellow pepper, and parsley; toss well.
instructions.7: Add salt and pepper to taste.
instructions.8: Remove the kunafa cups from the oven and let them cool slightly.
instructions.9: Fill the kunafa cups with the sauce, then the shawarma.
instructions.10: Drizzle more sauce on top.

fah-431.title: Chicken Quesadilla
fah-431.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-431.culturalNotes: Add corn, red beans, and mushrooms for extra flavor. Serve the quesadilla with tomato sauce or hot sauce.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the onion, colored pepper, and tomato into small pieces.
instructions.3: Mix the salt, pepper, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder in a bowl.
instructions.4: Toss the chicken pieces in the seasoning and leave for 15 minutes.
instructions.5: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.6: Add the chicken pieces and stir until cooked.
instructions.7: Add the onion and stir until wilted.
instructions.8: Add the colored pepper and tomato and stir for 2 minutes.
instructions.9: Remove the mixture from the heat and set aside.
instructions.10: Heat the pan again and add a drop of oil.
instructions.11: Place the bread in the pan and add a little cheese on top.
instructions.12: Add some of the chicken mixture over the cheese.
instructions.13: Add a little more cheese on top.
instructions.14: Press the bread and flip until browned on both sides.

fah-432.title: Potato Kubbeh
fah-432.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-432.culturalNotes: Freeze the kubbeh after shaping for later use. Perfect for a Ramadan breakfast or lunch.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes until tender.
instructions.2: Drain the potatoes and mash them well.
instructions.3: Add the starch and salt to the mashed potatoes and mix until the dough holds together.
instructions.4: Add more starch if the dough is soft and sticky.
instructions.5: Prepare the seasoned ground meat filling.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into small balls.
instructions.7: Open each ball and stuff it with the seasoned meat.
instructions.8: Seal the kubbeh well and shape them.
instructions.9: Fry the kubbeh in hot oil until golden.
instructions.10: Serve the kubbeh on a bed of parsley with your favorite sauce.

fah-433.title: Pizza & Chocolate Balls
fah-433.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-433.culturalNotes: Add any fillings you prefer to the pizza balls. Serve the balls with tomato sauce or your favorite dip.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, and milk powder in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and mayonnaise gradually and knead well.
instructions.3: Add the warm water gradually until you get a soft, cohesive dough.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Mix the tomato sauce, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder, and thyme to make the pizza sauce.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into small balls and shape them.
instructions.7: Flatten each ball on a floured surface and place a teaspoon of pizza sauce in the center.
instructions.8: Add your favorite fillings (peppers, tomatoes, olives, cheese, pastrami, or chocolate) and seal the balls closed.
instructions.9: Arrange the balls on an oiled tray and let them rise for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the tops with the mixture of milk powder, sugar, Nescafe, and water.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Remove the balls from the oven and serve hot.

fah-434.title: Crispy Chicken Rolls
fah-434.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-434.culturalNotes: Freeze the rolls after coating, before frying. Fry them straight from the freezer until golden when needed.

instructions.1: Prepare the chicken: cut the chicken breasts into small pieces and place in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the spices: onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, smoked paprika, chili, instant stock, ginger powder, cardamom, and a tablespoon of salt. Mix well.
instructions.3: Mince the chicken: place the chicken in the food processor with half the spice mix and process until finely minced.
instructions.4: Make the rolls: spread the minced chicken thinly over the tortilla bread. Roll up the bread to form rolls.
instructions.5: Cut the rolls into small pieces using a toothpick.
instructions.6: Make the coating: in a bowl, mix the flour, starch, baking powder, the remaining spices, buttermilk, and salt. Add water gradually until you get a thick consistency.
instructions.7: Dip the rolls in the wet batter, then in the crispy coating.
instructions.8: Fry the rolls in plenty of hot oil until golden.
instructions.9: Make the sauce: mix the pickles, mayonnaise, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder, sugar, and black pepper.
instructions.10: Serve the rolls hot with the sauce.

fah-435.title: Crispy Shawarma Roll
fah-435.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-435.culturalNotes: Use any flatbread instead of tortilla. Add other vegetables like fresh tomatoes or cucumber for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Mix the Syrian shawarma mix with 3 tablespoons of oil in a dish.
instructions.2: Add the chicken strips and toss well.
instructions.3: Leave the chicken in the marinade for one hour.
instructions.4: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a pan and add the shawarma once the oil is hot.
instructions.5: Toss the shawarma occasionally until golden.
instructions.6: Prepare the sandwich sauce: mix 4 tablespoons of mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons of ketchup, a pinch of onion powder, a pinch of garlic powder, and 2 tablespoons of pickles.
instructions.7: Spread a spoonful of sauce on the tortilla, then add the shawarma, fried potatoes, and cheese.
instructions.8: Roll up the bread and secure it with skewers.
instructions.9: Prepare the egg-and-milk mixture and dip the roll in it.
instructions.10: Coat the roll in panko or ground breadcrumbs.
instructions.11: Heat the oil in a pan over high heat and fry the roll until golden.
instructions.12: Drain the roll of excess oil and serve with fried potatoes and the remaining sauce.
